picks.what: The city in ruins after its liberation, photograph
picks.why: only general view before modern times; ruined town along Tsemes Bay, September 1943

picks.what: The city and port across Tsemes Bay, photograph
picks.why: general view from the hills: harbor piers in front, city along the far shore

gaps: P0–P4: nothing; P5: only the 1943 ruins (event)
notes: #1 (1839) and #2 (1855) by Edmund Spencer show the empty bay of Sudzhuk-Kale before the town was founded in 1838 (Spencer traveled there in 1836), so they are not views of the city. #3–#5 are warships in the harbor with no town in view. #9 is a crop of #7; #7 is an embankment panorama, weaker than #8.
